questions.q: Have you ever been to a concert?
questions.answer: A few times, yes, mostly local ones. There's a special energy to live music that a recording just can't capture. Being surrounded by a crowd who love the same songs is genuinely [[exhilarating]].

questions.q: What kind of events are held in your town?
questions.answer: Mostly local fairs, religious gatherings and cultural programmes on national days. The Baishakhi fair is probably the biggest, with stalls selling handicrafts and snacks, and it draws a [[sizeable]] crowd from the surrounding villages.

questions.q: Do you enjoy going to public events?
questions.answer: I do, in moderation. Cultural fairs and festivals have a wonderful atmosphere, and I like being part of the crowd. Very large, [[chaotic]] events can be a bit much for me, though, so I pick and choose.

questions.q: Do you prefer watching events live or online?
questions.answer: Live, if possible, because the atmosphere is half the experience. Watching online is convenient, but it feels a bit [[detached]], as if you're looking in from the outside rather than actually taking part.

questions.q: Is there an event you would love to attend in the future?
questions.answer: I'd love to watch a cricket World Cup match in a big stadium, ideally with Bangladesh playing. Being among thousands of passionate fans would be a [[once-in-a-lifetime]] experience, and I'd happily travel abroad for it.
